subject: FinCo access onboarding: SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist kickoff
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex@finco.com>, Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: FinCo access onboarding: SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist kickoff

Alex / Jamie —

Thanks for the demo earlier. Looping Monica (CS) and Karthik (security) so we can align on access controls and implementation scope. Below is a short kickoff checklist and questions so we can lock an implementation plan and internal ownership ahead of the Prod cutover. I attached our SSO/SCIM template and a blank attribute CSV for your convenience.

Kickoff checklist (proposed):
- SAML/SSO: exchange metadata & test IdP connection (entityID, ACS URL, cert)
- SCIM: attribute mapping and scoping (groups vs users, custom attrs)
- IP allowlist: CIDR list for production egress and any jump hosts
- Service accounts: service-account usage patterns, roles, rotation cadence
- Org policies: required MFA, session timeouts, delegated admin roles
- Timeline: target staging cutover and production cutover dates

Questions for your team:
1) Who owns SCIM attribute mapping on your side (name + email)?
2) Do you have an existing SAML metadata endpoint or a static metadata file we should import?
3) Please share the production IP ranges (CIDR) that need allowlisting — we need both egress and inbound depending on your topology.
4) Any policy constraints around service account keys (HSM, short-lived tokens)?

Proposed owner assignments from our side:
- Mina (implementation lead) — overall coordination and SSO testing
- Monica (CS) — onboarding runbooks and verification with your app teams
- Karthik (security) — controls review and approval sign-off

Next steps: if you can send answers to 1–4 and the IP list, we’ll draft a mutual action plan and propose dates.

Attachments: SSO-SCIM-implementation-template.xlsx, scim-attribute-map.csv

Thanks —

Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-21T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinCo access onboarding: SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist kickoff

Mina —

Thanks, that checklist looks good. Quick answers below and I attached our current prod IP ranges as a text file.

1) SCIM owner: Jamie Lee (jamie.lee@finco.com) — he’ll be handling attribute mapping and group syncs.
2) SAML metadata: we host a metadata endpoint at https://sso.finco.com/metadata.xml (valid cert, rotates quarterly).
3) Prod IP ranges: see attached finco-ip-allowlist.txt — includes our NAT gateways and a couple of static jump hosts. If you need egress-only ranges for calls initiated by Redwood, use the NAT ranges labeled "egress".
4) Service accounts: we prefer short-lived tokens via our internal vault; long-lived keys are tightly restricted to vendor integrations and require approvals.

We expect security review to want cert rotation windows and SCIM scoping for groups. Can you propose a staging cutover next week (Aug 26) and prod cutover the following week (Sep 2)?

Happy to jump on a quick 30m call if helpful.

—Alex
Alex Barnes
Head of Integrations, FinCo

Monica / Karthik —

Forwarding Alex's answers and the IP list he attached. Please see my proposed split of tasks below; call this our internal MAP draft so we can share with FinCo tomorrow.

Internal MAP (draft):
- Mina: schedule SSO test window with FinCo, import metadata, validate ACS/EntityID mappings (due Aug 25)
- Monica: prepare runbook for staged user imports and acceptance criteria for group syncs (due Aug 25)
- Karthik: security review — cert rotation window, recommended session timeout, and service-account role matrix (due Aug 24)
- All: coordination call Thurs Aug 24 with FinCo to confirm staging cutover (Aug 26)

Notes: Jamie is handling SCIM mapping on their side. Alex said metadata endpoint rotates quarterly—let's confirm our timeline accounts for the next rotation in early Oct.

Let me know if those due dates look okay or if you want to swap items.

Mina

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinCo access onboarding: SCIM owner + IP ranges (planning)

Thanks — I ran a quick control review and attached a short roles/approvals PDF. High-level recommendations before staging: 

- SAML: validate metadata endpoint for signed assertions and enforce audience checks on the assertion. We should require the IdP to sign both the response and assertion.
- Certificate rotation: request a cert overlap window of 7 days for the next rotation; schedule a smoke test during that window.
- SCIM: limit attribute writes for any "admin" group mapping; use group scoping to avoid wide assignment sweeps. Jamie should provide a stripped-down attribute set for initial sync.
- IP allowlist: accept the NAT egress CIDRs for outbound calls. For inbound webhooks, require FinCo to direct to our dedicated webhook gateway IPs only (we'll supply those).
- Service accounts: require short-lived tokens (<= 1 hour) issued from their vault or via OIDC; if long-lived keys are necessary, require HSM-backed storage and quarterly rotation.

I attached service-account-roles.pdf with the proposed RBAC mappings and the approvals flow. I can be on the Thurs call for final sign-off.

Karthik
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Alex / Jamie / FinCo network team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the IP list. Per internal review, we have a small set of follow-ups and a proposed schedule.

Outstanding items:
- Jamie: please send the initial SCIM attribute CSV with the minimal write attributes (username, email, groups) by EOD Aug 24 so Monica can prepare the runbook.
- FinCo network-team: confirm the NAT egress CIDRs in finco-ip-allowlist.txt are the authoritative list for prod. We will provide our webhook gateway IPs (expected by EOD Aug 24).
- Alex: confirm you are OK with the cert overlap window (7 days) for the next rotation and that we schedule the smoke test during that window.

Proposed schedule:
- Aug 24 (tomorrow): internal prep complete, exchange any missing artifacts (we will upload our SSO test ACS and webhook gateway IPs)
- Aug 26: staging cutover window (2–4pm PT) — SSO test + first SCIM run against staging tenants
- Sep 2: production cutover window (2–4pm PT) — final sync and smoke tests

I uploaded the mutual action plan draft to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFINCO. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the Aug 24 coordination call.

Attachments we are sharing now: SSO-SCIM-implementation-template.xlsx, scim-attribute-map.csv, finco-ip-allowlist.txt, service-account-roles.pdf

If that all looks good, we’ll send an invite for Thu Aug 24 10:00am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth rollout.

Mina Haddad
